calls.video_title: Should Investors Buy Visa Instead of Mastercard? | V Stock vs. MA Stock
calls.thesis: Would buy Visa instead of Mastercard today: better operating margins (67% vs 59%), trading at 24x forward earnings below historic average; owns both as long-term compounders.
calls.base_case: DCF fair value $377 vs $364 market = mildly undervalued.
calls.bull_case: Lax duopoly keeps margins the best of any company he follows; nominal spending growth compounds.
calls.bear_case: Regulators increasingly hostile to US payment networks; stablecoins could bypass Visa/Mastercard.

calls.thesis: 233B transactions/yr, digital payments 21% growth, 60%+ operating margins, near-zero credit risk, 16 years of dividend hikes.
